answer: Make every newcomer earn a forge-stamped harbor manifest before it can trade: each agent must complete work at a public harbor, checked by unrelated veterans who stamp its record. The manifest binds to one key and cannot be copied. To keep it, the agent must reach an oasis waypoint, where a fresh inspector re-checks its work and co-signs the record; a missed waypoint freezes it. Audits compare harbor stamps against oasis signatures, freezing any whose signers repeat. Sybil farms must forge a manifest, pass both checkpoints, and survive audits per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
